status: exploratory protocol saved before new controls; old result inspection acknowledged; no new final test or external preregistration
cases: same150 matched state/origin/lead event cases in2024-25 as last TimesFM/Chronos comparison;128 state/origin tasks; unchanged cases hash
calendar: same13 ordinary weekday/harmonic channels; add0/1/7 event channels with same main/regional ledger and relative-day definitions as existing Ridge controls

placebo.construction: One shift per year shared across all states. Move full regional anchor constellation by a multiple of seven within +/-42 days; exclude any overlap of placebo windows with true regional windows in any state. Random choice uses dates only. This is approximate seasonal and exact weekday matching, not exchangeability/causal evidence.

feature_rules: Reuse calendar_controls.covariates numerical construction, but select these9 declared arms. No target values enter calendar/placebo selection. Keep dates/cases fixed across all controls. Compare generic/regional within same dimension; generic_window vs generic_7/regional_window vs regional_7 measure encoding change, not isolated dimension. Zero controls may be dropped as constants by model preprocessing; report actual behavior and do not call them equal active information. Placebo channels provide nonconstant controls.
metrics: MAE/MASE per state/year/lead, equal state/year average; individual years retained. Means of per-state/year relative MAE changes secondary. Quantile crossing recorded; no sorting/clipping or significance claims.
reuse_policy: Do not adopt prior forecasts as new controls without exact source/model/package/config/input proof. Default fresh inference; use no data/feature/model/cache bypass. Preserve all original experiment artifacts.
limitations: two historical event clusters and correlated states/days
fixed seeded placebo not randomization distribution
no new-method or regional-provenance causality claim
no modification of frozen prospective forecasts; outcomes pending
